newsitem.title: POLAND: Firm involving Exbud signs 59.6 mln zloty contract.
newsitem.headline: Firm involving Exbud signs 59.6 mln zloty contract.

text.p: Construction firm Exbud SA said Energomontaz Zachod SA, in which it holds a 46.7 percent stake, signed a 59.6 million zloty contract with the T. Kosciuszko electricity plant in Polaniec, southeast Poland.

Exbud said in a statement on Wednesday the contract was for the supply of equipment and buildings for a plant processing limestone, plaster and briquettes. Work is to start this month and finish in June 1998.
